MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 3 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 10
   C. 12
   D. 9

2. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 36
   D. 42

3. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

4. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 5
   C. 36
   D. 13

5. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 82
   C. 81
   D. 18

6. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 26

7. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 1
   C. 20
   D. 21

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 156

9. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 65
   D. 64

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 5
   C. 7
   D. 7

11. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 26

12. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 2

13. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

14. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 29
   C. 11
   D. 3

15. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

16. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 90

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
